title: AKB Knowledge Unit Specification
description: Schema defining atomic YAML knowledge units (standards, rules, and architecture decisions) for AI coding assistants.

id.description: Unique immutable identifier for this knowledge unit (e.g. ARCH-SYS-001, DEV-TS-001, ADR-001).

type.description: Category type of the knowledge unit.

title.description: Human-readable title summarizing the unit directive.

domain.description: Bounded context or architectural domain (e.g. architecture, development, product, decisions, billing, core).

version.description: Semantic version of this knowledge unit specification.

team.description: Team name responsible for enforcing this rule.

applies_to.description: List of file globs, directory paths, or component tags to which this invariant strictly applies.

rule.description: Primary normative architectural rule or directive enforced by this unit.

do.description: Prescriptive action items and best practices that developers and AI agents must follow.

dont.description: Strict prohibitions and anti-patterns that must not be introduced.

reason.description: Architectural rationale explaining why this invariant is necessary.

related_items.description: Cross-reference IDs to related Knowledge Units (e.g. ARCH-SYS-001).

guard_patterns.description: Optional explicit AST S-expression (ast_query) and/or regular expression rules enforced by akbo guard / akbo check.

pattern.description: Fallback or primary regular expression pattern.

ast_query.description: Optional Tree-sitter S-expression query evaluated on parsed AST nodes.

strictAstOnly.description: If true, skip regex fallback when AST runtime is unavailable.

skill_file.description: Relative path to the original human-curated SKILL.md file if imported from an agent skill.

reference_files.description: Discovered companion reference documentation files (e.g. references/*.md) supporting this skill.

workflow_gates.description: Ordered procedural implementation gates or verification steps extracted from the skill.
